name: cpu-large
cmd: bun --eval 'import {cpus,hostname,arch,platform} from "node:os"; import {readFileSync} from "node:fs"; console.log("CPU_QUALIFICATION "+JSON.stringify({hostname:hostname(),models:[...new Set(cpus().map(c=>c.model))],cpuCount:cpus().length,arch:arch(),platform:platform(),bootId:readFileSync("/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id","utf8").trim(),procModels:[...new Set(readFileSync("/proc/cpuinfo","utf8").split("\n").filter(l=>l.startsWith("model name")))]}));'
